p1: A dead man on a beach had a secret pocket. Inside, a note that means: it is ended.
Adelaide, 1948. Found at dawn, lying against the sea wall.
The night before, a couple saw him lift his arm... and let it drop.
No wallet. No ID. Labels cut out of his clothes.
The pathologist was sure it wasn't natural. No poison was ever found.
The note was torn from the last page of a Persian poetry book.
A man later handed police that exact book. Found in a parked car near the beach.
The torn page matched. In the back... five lines of letters. A code.
In 2022, DNA from his hair gave researchers a name: Carl Webb.
Police still haven't confirmed it. And the code? Still unsolved.
